title: A rental bond reads as spending, and its refund as a negative purchase
found: BPAY RESIDENTIAL TENANCIES BOND books as a purchase of $7,200 in March 2027 and the refund as a refund in February 2028. Only the $185 cleaning charge was ever spent.
want: Money held by a third party: an asset, a question at worst. A person can already decide it. A dictionary entry would make it right first time.
